summary: Delta audit of the CURRENT build (rebuilt Figs 2-3, expanded body, new Section 5): all 8 checks PASS. (1) Fig3 timelines: positional (x/y) parse of fig3-answers-dual.svg recovers every 'xN' line in all five mode cards (BQ04 a/b/c, BQ06 a/c); recomputed tool_use counts from track_{a,b,c}_BQ04 / track_{a,c}_BQ06 match exactly per tool and in column total (a/BQ04 ToolSearch 2 + kb_search_vector 2 + kb_search_two_stage 1 = 5; b/BQ04 Glob 1 + Grep 1 + Read 2 = 4; c/BQ04 ToolSearch 1 + kb_search_vector 1 = 2; a/BQ06 ToolSearch 3 + kb_search_vector 5 + kb_doc_read 2 = 10; c/BQ06 1 + 1 = 2), each equal to the trace's tool_call_count. (2) All five VERBATIM ANSWER EXCERPT fragments are exact substrings of the saved answers after removing ** / ` and collapsing whitespace (incl. the shortened B/BQ04 and C/BQ06 fragments) - no fragment missing. (3) Strip values in svg AND rendered fig3 PDF: 9/10 10/10 9/10 (grounded), 9/10 6/10 6/10 (kw-verified), 7/10 4/10 1/10 (part/section), 113.0 42.7 48.0 (latency), 7.6 4.4 2.4 (tool calls), 0.4911 0.1631 0.1803 (cost/q) + label 'A Platform - B Bare agent - C Dense' - all re-derived from exp_r2_grade.json and audit_paper_numbers.json (per-question cost sums give 0.49105/0.16315/0.18035). (4) Fig2 final-check banner (identical in HTML SVG, PNG render source, and fig2-architecture.pdf text) lists 8 labels with 'vector probe (x2)' counted twice = 9 recordings, mapping 1:1 onto 103_final_check.py's nine keys C1_readback, C2_desc, C3_tags, C4_kb, A6V_vec_probe, C5_vector, C7_graph, C8_three_layer, C9_meta_hit (C6 skipped in the script; the probe is recorded under both A6V and C5 keys - hence x2). (5) Fig2 badges exactly: '>= 6 Cited answer - sources name base / document / part / section' (solid), '= 5 Qualified answer - usable score-5 backstop, attributed' (dashed), '<= 4 Not-found - scope / near miss / reason / remedy' (dashed), plus dashed librarian strip; all present in the rendered PDF and matching Section 2.3's flow and knowledgebase-search SKILL.md (>=6 fast exit, 5 = P1 backstop adopted with attribution, <=4 discarded, gate failure -> librarian fallback). (6) Section 5: '(9/10 each)' = platform gold_hit 9 and kw_ok 9; 'roughly three times the bare agent's cost' = 0.4911/0.1631 = 3.01x; '100 papers, five bases, 322 stored parts' matches the fact sheet. (7) Section 2: read-back / vector probe / three-layer consistency are each among the nine 103 keys; '41 kb_* tools' consistent where stated (Section 2.1 + 94-tool inventory, Fig2 band 1, Fig2 caption; abstract states no count); Section 4 '7.6 platform, 4.4 bare, 2.4 dense' = audit per_track avg_tool_calls. (8) Regression: abstract numbers unchanged and all re-derived (9/10/9 grounded, 9/6/6 verified, 7/4/1 citations, ~3x cost, 3 scripted not-found probes); Section 3 'from ten seconds to about three minutes' brackets observed latency min 13.8s / max 174.0s (BQ01 track a); no 'stored documents' in any live tex (only in stale tex/_r1_extract.txt); main.pdf (built 2026-09-24 02:01:56, newer than all tex and both figure PDFs) has 0 '??', 0 [?], no undefined/multiply-defined warnings, all cite keys present in refs.bib; body ends on page 4 with the Conclusion, page 5 = GenAI disclosure + references; 'stored parts' / parts terminology intact throughout. One P2 informational note: the brief names fig2-architecture.svg, but the fig2 build emits fig2-architecture.html (embedded SVG, what the gates and PNG/PDF render from) + PDF + PNG; no standalone .svg exists in figures/submission-20260922 - audited the embedded SVG and the PDF text instead. Not a paper defect.
